name: Access to Crystal Mines (Holtburg portal)
title: Access to Crystal Mines
summary: acpedia's Access to Crystal Mines is six giant platforms suspended in the air west of the Mount Esper crater (70.5N 8.1W), five with portals to the Crystal Mine versions, reached by a portal on the ground near Holtburg at 46.8N 30.5E. The platforms lie in landblock 0x75D7, which is missing from the kit, so only the Holtburg-side access portal is filmed: a portal swirl and the NPC Tornash on a bare grassy hilltop (z 129, the highest ground 1.1 km north-west of Holtburg) with a 36 m pine 26 m west.

site.name: Access to Crystal Mines (Holtburg portal)
site.notes: The gazetteer teleport for this portal lands ON the portal swirl (risk of the hidden player being portalled away); derived @teleloc 15 m south-south-west of it on open grass instead. The acpedia POI's six floating platforms are at 70.5N 8.1W (landblock 0x75D7, not in the kit) and are NOT filmed; this site is the Holtburg-side access portal at 46.8N 30.5E.
